rule.name: E3_RAPID_SUPPORT_FAILURE
rule.ATR: Original 14-completed-15m ATR recorded before the first 5m bar; freeze for the entire 10m pair.
rule.rapid: A.open - B.close >= 1.0 * frozen pre-window ATR; A/B adjacent complete 5m bars.
rule.support: H is the entry-time confirmed 15m HL, fixed for this trade. A.close < H.
rule.persistence: B.high < H and B.close < H: entire following 5m never reclaims H, including wick touches.
rule.direction: B.close < B.open; B.close <= A.close; neither full-range nor body inside A.
rule.after_entry: A starts at/after the next full 5m boundary following the original entry minute.
rule.no_profit_gate: Does not require 1R profit, a new high, or a new H-L-LH pattern.
rule.execution: At B.end + 60 seconds use the exact real 1m open as a model reference; never use B.close or a support threshold as a retrospective fill.
rule.missing: No incomplete pair or absent ATR. Missing exact execution minute cancels that attempt; later complete fresh windows may qualify. No fill/price carry-forward.
rule.receipt: For the live-prefix case, all signal inputs must have actually arrived before the chosen execution minute. Monthly contemporaneous receipts unavailable: +60s is an explicit model assumption, not observed latency.
rule.priority: Original exits through the E3 execution minute retain priority. Preserve any earlier/same-minute 25% leg and sell only current remainder; final original exit at/before due suppresses E3. Flag same-minute ambiguity.
rule.fraction: 100% of then-remaining shares, no new entries or reentry.
rule.unchanged: Original entries, stop/target formulas, original earlier exits and costs remain; only one independent hypothetical exit overlay is evaluated.
rule.selection: Exactly Nov15 01:44 case and the nine prior-audit winners; no new month run, parameter search or live promotion.
